findings.criterion: Header/classification rationale/history conform to the four-Type policy, stable identity and actual contribution. No inherited approval, Baseline or responsibility for later changed bytes is implied.
findings.observed_evidence: Header and §§2/3/16.1/16.2 justify Structure by catalog/organization responsibility; Architecture is Family. Stable ID/path, V2.0 R1 Draft/unassigned and actual contribution; received declarations and absent Author preserved. No inherited approval, membership or responsibility for later bytes.

findings.criterion: All 23 entries occur once in the register with 4/4/5/5/5 allocation and stable names; all three views distinguish entity/capability/area meanings. No extra or relocated component is inferred from a concern, directory or diagram label.
findings.observed_evidence: §4 register contains exactly 23 original names/section numbers, one primary allocation each, matching Layers in 4/4/5/5/5. Seven structural areas differ from five concerns. Supporting definitions and Automation grouping create no extra component; cross-cutting participation preserves ownership.

findings.criterion: Each view and new assertion states its meaning; every required edge has consumer/provider, contract/scope and source edition. Genuine requirements and cycles are not concealed by labels. No global acyclicity or consumer conformity is claimed.
findings.observed_evidence: §§4/10/12 separate allocation, typed associations and required consumption. Seven rows exactly match Layers/Concepts and Blueprint pairs; provider support precedence and two same-Layer requirements explicit. Genuine requirements/cycles remain visible and cycles prohibited; complete graph and conformity not claimed.

findings.criterion: §5 responsibilities retain their intended support roles with explicit domain ownership and applicability, no invented catalog/Profile or mandatory normalized identity for functional files. Representation, logical identity, edition and classification remain distinct; no path/ID migration is inferred.
findings.observed_evidence: §§3/5 apply all-location functional exclusions and retain four Documentation roles. Metadata represents owner meanings; Dictionary/Schema/Profile/Instance and one effective Profile explicit. Logical identity, edition, classification and membership distinct; Templates definition/instance separated. No catalog/Profile, ID/path migration or automatic consistency invented.
findings.related_records_retain_prior_scope: INV-02 remains Not applicable; REV2-03/04/06/07/08; ARC003-03/04; ARC004-04

findings.criterion: Governance/verification/executor boundaries and exact-edition snapshot gates are explicit; no successful check or adapter automatically approves, publishes, selects membership or retargets earlier editions.
findings.observed_evidence: §6 separates contract capabilities, DMS/tool/manual execution and CMS scope. Reviews records findings; Validation and Consistency Verification supply scoped evidence without approval authority. Exact immutable approved-edition Baselines require explicit selection and pinned context; eligibility, consistency and inclusion distinct. §§9.2/9.4 publishing consumes authorization.

findings.criterion: Discovery capability boundaries distinguish authoritative records from traceable projections and consumers; relationships are not restricted to dependencies or used to hide actual required edges. No unverified pipeline, completeness or global consistency is asserted.
findings.observed_evidence: §7 distinguishes typed endpoint/provenance records from catalog/network projections and Navigation/Search consumers. Derived copies retain source editions and freshness/state. Relations include semantic and required kinds; no universal Registry pipeline, domain ownership transfer or complete graph asserted.

findings.criterion: All five Automation responsibilities have explicit owner-contract/executor/evidence limits, retaining intended generation/check domains without manufactured values, semantic authority, automatic conformity or a deployed implementation claim.
findings.observed_evidence: §8 retains five Automation roles with exact inputs/outputs, owner rules, execution evidence, provenance and coverage limits. Completion cannot invent missing values or semantics; generation/verification supplies no automatic conformity, deployment, approval or guaranteed outcome.

findings.criterion: Five Integration roles retain canonical names/allocation and state applicable contract/authorization/executor limits. No automatic publication, new approval authority, mandatory ecosystem or unsupported implementation evidence remains.
findings.observed_evidence: §9 retains five Integration names/allocations as optional supported adapters. Source-control, pipeline, IDE and platform roles consume contracts and exact-edition publication authorization. AI attribution is actual contribution, separate from authorization/approval; later bytes need assessment without inherited results or product-consequence responsibility.

findings.criterion: Characteristics/evolution/conclusion use bounded claims and a concrete compatibility/impact path; no architecture-free extension or automatic quality/independence guarantee remains.
findings.observed_evidence: §§11/15/16.1 bound cohesion, independence, reuse, extension and quality objectives. Changes require demonstrated need, owner/consumer mapping, compatibility assessment and transition evidence. Necessary incompatible normative reconciliation justifies V1.0 to V2.0 with monotonic R0 to R1; no harmless-extension or independent-release guarantee.

findings.criterion: Every operational reference resolves to an intended supplied identity; illustrative/unsupplied roles and partial comparison limits are explicit. Numbering/input/history/view provenance traceable without invented specification IDs, historic authors or completed peer cycles.
findings.observed_evidence: §§13/14 resolve fourteen supplied identities, including four actual detailed specifications and the singular Template Specification title. Five other exact-title roles remain bounded conceptual responsibilities. Original numbering, input and three received-view digests preserved; no historic author, external absence or completed peer cycle fabricated.
